I routed all 34 backlog tickets (30 open, 4 pending) and commented `Routed to: <queue>` on each. I also created 14 handoff tickets, ids 946–959. I changed no statuses and touched no other tickets. `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

I used the 2026-08 routing rules, the component catalog and ownership-changes as of 2026-09-14. The 2025 docs are superseded, so I ignored them.

Ownership details that decided routing:
- `search-api` counts as `data`, because its transfer takes effect at 00:00 UTC today.
- `export-jobs` counts as `payments`, because the 2026-09-10 transfer beats the 2026-08-10 one.
- `ledger-worker` counts as `data`.
- The `status-page` transfer (2026-09-21) hasn't taken effect yet, so it stays with `platform`.
- The `notify-service` transfer was withdrawn, so it stays with `messaging`.

Three tickets didn't resolve to a normal queue:
- Ticket 911 names `billing-portal`, which isn't in the catalog, so it went to `triage-desk`.
- Ticket 937 has no `Component:` line, so it also went to `triage-desk`.
- Ticket 927 went to the fallback queue `data-emea` because `data` has no apac queue.
